This approach balances exploration (through perturbations) and exploitation (via local search) to escape local minima.

C₅ = max_k ∫ h(x)(1 - h(x + k)) dx

- 0 ≤ h[i] ≤ 1 ∀i
- ∑h[i] = n / 2
